test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which region in India has the highest concentration of Iron and Steel Industry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chotanagpur plateau**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Chotanagpur Plateau**, located in eastern India, specifically in Jharkhand, is rich in mineral resources, including iron ore, coal, and bauxite, making it the hub for iron and steel industries.
 
• Prominent iron and steel plants such as **Tata Steel (Jamshedpur)**, **Bokaro Steel Plant**, and **Rourkela Steel Plant** are situated in and around this region.
 
• The availability of high-grade iron ore and coal in close proximity ensures lower transportation costs and efficient production processes for steel manufacturing.
 
• This plateau is also strategically located near major rivers such as Damodar and Subarnarekha, ensuring water supply for industrial operations.
 
• Chotanagpur’s mineral-rich geology and infrastructure contribute to it being the backbone of India's iron and steel industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Iron Ore:**

 
 
• India is one of the leading producers of iron ore globally, with deposits found mainly in Odisha, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Karnataka, and Goa.
 
• Iron ore is the primary raw material used in steel production, accounting for 98% of mined iron globally.
 
 
 
• **Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC):**
 
 
• Established in 1948, DVC serves as a critical source of power and water supply for industries in the Chotanagpur Plateau.
 
• Its thermal power plants are key contributors to the industrial energy needs of the region.
 
 
 
• **Tata Steel:**
 
 
• Founded in 1907, Tata Steel's Jamshedpur plant is India’s oldest steel manufacturing facility and is located in the Chotanagpur Plateau.
 
• It played a pivotal role in the industrialization of India and continues to be a global leader in steel production.
 
 
 
• **Steel Industry in India:**
 
 
• India is the second-largest producer of steel globally, with a production capacity exceeding 120 million tonnes annually.
 
• The iron and steel industry is crucial to India's economy, contributing significantly to infrastructure development, manufacturing, and exports.
